summary.name: Proficient AI
summary.one_liner: A platform and API for developers to add conversational AI agents to their apps, managed through a web dashboard.
use_cases: Add a chatbot that answers customer questions
Build a virtual tutor for users
Embed an AI assistant in a React app
Create and configure agents from a backend
Connect an app to different LLMs without custom integration
summary.what_it_does: Proficient AI lets developers create an agent in a web dashboard, customize its configuration, and connect it to an app by adding a prebuilt UI component in a few lines of code. Agents are hosted in the Proficient cloud and can connect to various LLMs. The platform stores interactions and user data, which can be accessed through the API or admin dashboard. It offers two APIs: a Client API for client applications with restricted access, and an Admin API for backend applications to create, configure, delete agents and monitor interactions.
notable: Prebuilt UI component added in 3-5 lines of code
Separate Client API and Admin API for client and backend access
Connects to many LLMs without custom integration
Stores interactions and user data accessible via API or dashboard
caveats: Demo video dates from April 2023 and the page says newer features are not shown
Pricing is not stated on the page
